product: FieldDeck v0: used Advantech AIM8I rugged tablet + keyboard dock + Gigabit Ethernet + isolated RS-485/CAN/DI-DO field I/O
source_design: PR #111 (PF-003 Taiwan FieldDeck): donor NT$2,000, target MSRP NT$12,900, modeled COGS NT$6,633 of which 'FieldDock + FieldIO + new parts' is an unpriced NT$2,500 assumption
scope: A rugged field-service terminal. 'build' lines are what only the splice needs; 'shared' lines are the field I/O every route needs (a laptop or a Toughbook also needs isolated RS-485 and CAN adapters), so they are excluded from both sides of the comparison and added back for COGS. Alternatives are what a field engineer would buy instead.

lines.spec: used Advantech AIM8I tablet (condition unknown; #111 assumes 80% usable yield, unmeasured)
lines.exclude: 電池|BAT|充電|底座|座充|保護|皮套

lines.spec: power adapter for the donor (write-off listings do not say one is included)
lines.fixed_price_basis: ASSUMED generic adapter allowance; the AIM8I input rating and plug were not checked against a listing

lines.spec: compact wired/2.4 GHz keyboard with touchpad for the dock
queries: 迷你鍵盤 觸控板 有線
lines.must: 鍵盤.*(觸控板|觸摸板|touchpad)|(觸控板|觸摸板|touchpad).*鍵盤
lines.exclude: 保護膜|鍵帽|皮套|平板殼|iPad|ipad

lines.spec: USB 3.0 Gigabit Ethernet adapter (the AIM8I has no RJ45; a laptop or Toughbook does)
USB 3.0 4-port hub inside the dock (the donor exposes one USB 3.0 path through its dock connector)
printed clamshell dock body with hinge and tablet clamp
lines.fixed_price_basis: ASSUMED: scaled from the NT$526 3DEX quote for the drone frame+cradle (larger part plus hinge hardware); no dock design or quote exists

lines.spec: mating 16-pin dock / 14-pin extension connection (pogo block or cable) and internal wiring
lines.fixed_price_basis: ASSUMED: the AIM8I dock connector part number and pinout are not in hand; #111 lists real pin behaviour as an open gate

lines.spec: isolated USB to RS-485 converter (proxy for FieldIO's two isolated RS-485 channels)
queries: 隔離 USB RS485 轉換器
lines.exclude: 非隔離|TTL|模組板|PLC程式|乙太網|網路|以太網|WiFi|4G|RS232.*RS485.*RS422.*TTL

lines.spec: USB to CAN adapter, isolated where listed (proxy for FieldIO's CAN channel)
queries: USB 轉 CAN 分析儀

lines.spec: USB optically isolated digital I/O / relay module (proxy for FieldIO's protected DI/DO)
queries: USB 光耦隔離 IO 模組
USB 繼電器模組 光耦隔離
